XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Failure of the engine to shut down with the Start&Stop system, with the fault indicator light coming
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: BRAKES | P0504 | SWITCH | STOP | INACTIVE | FAILURE | IGNITION | WHEN STOPPING | SWITCHES OFF | STOP | SWITCHES ON | ON | A | CIRCULATED | YELLOW |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not documented by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Cars fitted with a Start&Stop system

  • System: Brakes

  • Component: Stop switch

  • Fault: Engine fails to shut off when stationary with the Start&Stop system, with the fault indicator light coming on sporadically

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P0504 (Brake switch 1-2 signal – Incorrect signal)

  • Cause: Faulty stop switch

• Task: Check that the stop switch is working correctly and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located in the passenger compartment above the brake pedal.

    The estimated time for the service is approximately 0.4 h.
